why: The assertion no other corpus can make, and the reason this one exists. `length_km` is `type: number` and the three reaches measure 10, 9 and 7; `length_km>9` returns exactly the 10. As text, `"10"` sorts before `"9"` and a lexical implementation answers ZERO rows here — the trap RFC-0018 deferred the ordering operators over, now reachable because a numeric type exists. Over `corpus-dated/` the trap is invisible: fixed-width dates order the same as text and as values, so a server comparing text passes every date case. This is the query #1030 was opened for, and it is the shortfall of the dangerous kind — fewer rows reads as a corpus with less in it, not as a query answered wrongly.
